audit_hypotheses.definition: hypotheses from USGS drill-core logs and GemPy worlds

false_acceptance_rate.definition: accepted incorrect hypotheses divided by all incorrect hypotheses

synthetic_preference_pairs.definition: synthetic chosen/rejected challenger preferences used for RLAIF training

hidden_borehole_predictive_accuracy_gain.definition: challenger prediction accuracy improvement over direct judging at equal audit budget

full_verification_fraction.definition: cases routed to full simulator verification divided by audited cases

silent_regressions_caught.definition: silent quality regressions identified by nightly evaluation before promotion

measurement_files.new_reports: written to the configured output directory by evaluation and training commands
